candidates.title: [ux-sim] Internship pages for Bay Area listings never say if it is paid or when it closes
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Both internship personas reached a verified listing but had to guess pay and deadline; federal listings do show "Paid · $…". No "Paid only" or field filter.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Imported Bay Area listings lack pay/deadline fields; filters only cover type/location/deadline.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261108-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley` step 13 — “OK, it's real and checked today, and I know how to apply. But is it paid? When does it cl” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/shots/013-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/shots/013-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley` step 28 — “Software engineer, software engineer, software engineer... I'm a History major.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/028-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/028-scroll-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261108-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/report.md), [`sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `diego-transfer-commuter`, `marcus-senior-lowtech` · scenarios: `internship-near-berkeley`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Show "Pay: unknown — see posting" explicitly; add Paid-only and Field filters.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] A leftover search word silently empties the filter results ("No results" for Bay Area internships)
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Marcus typed "Berkeley", then picked Internships + Bay Area: "No results", disabled button, nothing showing the search was still applied; closing the sheet discarded the picks.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Filter sheet counts results with the hidden search query; sheet state is not kept on close.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley` step 9 — “No internships in the Bay Area? At Berkeley? That can't be right. Maybe it's because I ty” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/009-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/009-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley` step 4 — “It just found anything with 'Berkeley' in it. Tokyo isn't near Berkeley.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/004-type.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/004-type-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261108-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `marcus-senior-lowtech` · scenarios: `internship-near-berkeley`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Show the active search as a chip inside the filter sheet with "clear"; keep picks when the sheet closes.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).
